supersedes.reason: Revision 2 correctly restored leafcutter-only cell-sQTL selection, but its shared qtl_payloads fact conflated distinct GTEx tissue-eQTL, GTEx tissue-sQTL, cell-eQTL and cell-sQTL input families. It did not separately expose the missing human brain-pericyte expression reference, treated the 75-column Allen MTG subtype matrix as sufficient broad-class software without a frozen aggregation map, treated GSE67835 unadjusted enrichment as executable replication without a cross-atlas alignment/classifier, and treated Pair A-versus-B comparison as software-ready without a pinned comparator. It also did not bind each supported interpretation analysis to the complete preparation/runner/recorder/BH-collation code family, did not expose the absent broad-tissue MAGMA adapter, omitted the ready ABC/PCHiC link bundles from regulatory-chain evidence, and did not separately block the intended 18-tissue S-LDSC family when its locally frozen family contains only 16 selected tissues plus control and omits Lung index 36 and Muscle_Skeletal index 38. Revision 3 corrects all of those result-blind readiness boundaries, adds exact 49-context GTEx eQTL payload/index probes, and splits three-way and regulatory-chain eQTL/sQTL units. No result was read and no statistical threshold, model, locus, trait or multiple-testing correction was changed.
